title.narrative: Institutionalizing Performance, Monitoring and Evaluation in OECS countries in the CARICOM Region

description.narrative: Background The FY06 OECS CAS included as intermediate indicators in key areas - such as improving the efficiency of the delivery of public services, improving the quality of social protection programs and mitigating vulnerability to natural disasters - the need to obtain baseline data and a solid system of monitoring and evaluation to improve public sector performance. In addition, the OECS CEM (FY05) stated the need of increasing M&E efforts and carrying out rigorous impact evaluations of programs in order to analyze to improve the value of government's resources. This proposal has been prepared in coordination with CARICAD and is supported by the CMU. Objective Lack of performance information about public programs and projects prevents effective and efficient management of public resources. A first step to solve the problem will be to generate and make accessible performance information to decision makers. Higher-order outcome: Increase the relevance, effectiveness and efficiency of public programs and projects in the OECS members of CARICOM. Intermediate outcome: Performance information from priority public programs and projects is available to decision makers in OECS countries in CARICOM. The long term objective of the proposed IDF is to increase the relevance, effectiveness and efficiency of public programs and projects in the Organization of Eastern Caribbean States (OECS) members of the Caribbean Community (CARICOM). The intermediate objective is to make performance information from priority public programs and projects available to decision makers and to create capacity within Member States to both generate and use this performance information.
